name: Cassiar Gold Corp.
summary: Cassiar Gold Corp. engages in the acquisition, exploration, and development of mineral properties. Its principal assets include the Cassiar gold project that covers 56,000 hectares of mineral claims located in northern British Columbia, as well as Sheep Creek gold district project comprising Bayonne and Sheep Creek properties situated in Salmo, British Columbia. The company was formerly known as Margaux Resources Ltd. and changed its name to Cassiar Gold Corp. in September 2020. Cassiar Gold Corp. was incorporated in 2009 and is based in Calgary, Canada.
